Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

qvdr (development version)

qvdr 0.1.0

New features

  • read_qvd(): Read a QVD file into a tibble with full type coercion. Supports col_select for column subsetting and n_max for row limiting.
  • qvd_metadata(): Read only the XML header — table name, record count, field names, types, and tags — without loading any data.
  • qvd_fields(): Return just the field names from a QVD header.
  • qvd_schema(): Return a tibble with per-field schema including inferred R type, QVD type, Qlik tags, distinct value count, and bit width.
  • C++ backend (Rcpp) for high-performance bit-packed index extraction.
  • Automatic type coercion: integer, double, Date ($date tag), POSIXct ($timestamp tag), and character.
  • Full support for QVD symbol types: INT32 (0x01), DOUBLE (0x02), STRING (0x04), DUAL_INT (0x05), DUAL_DBL (0x06).
  • Informative error messages via cli.
  • Progress bar for large files via cli.
